verdict.rationale: Vanta has no documented one-click or bulk data export. Its Manage Vanta API can list documents, policies, and evidence ([vanta-docs-1]), and it is pitched for programmatically extracting data to custom dashboards ([vanta-docs-24], [vanta-docs-58]). The Auditor API can pull controls and evidence ([vanta-docs-29]), so a determined user could script their own export. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or bulk export feature, explicit open-format export (e.g. CSV/JSON archives), assurance that all data types (tests, risks, vendors, questionnaires) are exportable, offboarding/data-portability documentation, and independent corroboration.
